title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?

Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch till the end for the big reveal! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #Puzzle #Reveal

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON — but which one?!
We've got a sparkly blue egg, a spotty red egg, and a golden egg. Pick your favorite NOW!
The answer is coming! Three… two… one…
The blue egg cracks open and out pops… a rubber duck! Quack quack — no dragon here!
The red egg cracks open and it's… a tiny frog! Cute, but still no dragon!
That means the GOLDEN egg is the one! It cracks open and out comes a baby dragon — ROAR!
Did YOU get it right? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
